|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Imperial Propaganda (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The images here are the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-imperialpropaganda-pre.gif]]) and the Virtual Block 4 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-26-Imperial_Propaganda.png]]); both show this text. The PC-E1 text is shown by a CardMaker recreation on [[Imperial Propaganda (V) (Errata)]].
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “If you are about to lose Force during opponent's control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 2. Whenever you lose force during opponent's control phase (except from a Force drain at a battleground or your card), that loss is cumulatively -1 (to a minimum of 1).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Imperial Propaganda (V) (Errata)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) added “Non-[Virtual Block 4] Imperial Propaganda is canceled.” (slip marked E): “If you are about to lose Force during opponent's control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 2. Whenever you lose force during opponent's control phase (except from a Force drain at a battleground or your card), that loss is cumulatively -1 (to a minimum of 1). Non-[Virtual Block 4] Imperial Propaganda is canceled.”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee posted this errata on its rules forum on 14 June 2013, effective immediately, as a “repost of recent errata from the CBT” (the first announcement has not been found)<ref name="pcforum-p813434">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 14 June 2013 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=20#p813434 forum post])</ref>, so this version was in force by 14 June 2013. The Master List that prints it was compiled until February 2014, so its 27 April 2013 date does not date this change.
